sections.title: Partners rotate. Everyone gets on court.
sections.lead: Players give their level before the session. {{brand.name}} plans each round across your courts so nobody plays with the same partner twice until the rotation runs out.
ticks: As many courts as you have

sections.title: From empty courts to a waitlist.

steps.title: Levels in, courts planned
steps.body: Players give their level before the session. Rounds are planned so everyone gets about the same time on court.

steps.title: Check in, then play
steps.body: Players check in at the desk. Anyone arriving late joins the next round.

steps.title: A new partner every round
steps.body: Phones show the next court and partner between games.

steps.title: Court time, counted
steps.body: You see every player’s minutes on court and on the bench. Anyone sitting out is pointed to the café to mix.

steps.title: Standings, then the photos
steps.body: Reveal the final standings at the end, and the photos follow. Your guest records show which non-members keep coming.

items.question: Does {{brand.name}} replace our court booking system?
items.answer: No. Keep your booking system for court hire. {{brand.name}} runs the socials and memberships on top.

items.question: Which sports work?
items.answer: Pickleball, padel, badminton, tennis and anything played in pairs on courts. You set the courts and round length.

items.question: Can members play free?
items.answer: Yes. A membership can include sessions at 100% off, or a member price.

items.question: Can coaches run sessions on {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: Yes. Add them to your team, and give each coach a link to see who they bring in.

items.question: Do players need an app?
items.answer: No. They book and see their next court in their phone’s browser.

items.question: We have several locations.
items.answer: Each location can have its own page. Ask us for a walkthrough and we’ll set it up.
